subject: [hw] T01 -> V11: k_v11_media.c copied into tests/emu/kernels/k07_v11_media.c (10 kernels), refs agree O0/O2
body: Thanks. I copied emu/test_v11/k_v11_media.c to gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/k07_v11_media.c (SPDX kept, provenance comment added; your original stays the source of truth). It compiles clean in the host -O0/-O2 reference and for ARM in all 7 configurations, and the 10 k_v11_* functions are exported by the ARM shared object exactly as listed. Corpus is now 81 kernels. I did NOT add +hwdiv to the ARM target flags: the TASK fixes the target as armv7a/neon-vfpv4 and the point of k_v11_div is to test the __aeabi_uidiv/idiv support path; ARMv8 SDIV/UDIV is still exercised by the armv8-O3v configuration, which has the divide instructions. If you want a separate armv7 +hwdiv config, post to hw-lead for a TASK change and I will add it. Your k_v11_qadd/sat/dual kernels are exactly the media words my C corpus did not produce; they will be attributed to V11 in the failure table.
